description: This file defines a 'Kpi' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, associated with the 'ohrm_kpi' database table. It includes properties such as id, title, ratings, deletion timestamp, and related job title, along with getter and setter methods. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping and includes a decorator trait.

classes.name: Kpi
classes.description: Entity class representing a KPI (Key Performance Indicator) with ORM mappings and properties such as id, title, ratings, associated job title, and deletion timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the KPI.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the KPI.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the KPI.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the KPI.

methods.name: getMinRating
methods.description: Returns the minimum rating value for the KPI.

methods.name: setMinRating
methods.description: Sets the minimum rating value for the KPI.

methods.name: getMaxRating
methods.description: Returns the maximum rating value for the KPI.

methods.name: setMaxRating
methods.description: Sets the maximum rating value for the KPI.

methods.name: isDefaultKpi
methods.description: Checks if this KPI is marked as default.

methods.name: setDefaultKpi
methods.description: Sets whether this KPI is the default.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle with this KPI.

methods.name: getDeletedAt
methods.description: Returns the DateTime when the KPI was marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeletedAt
methods.description: Sets the deletion timestamp for the KPI.
